svg.title: Search and rescue worker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as search and rescue worker, wearing a rescue jacket and a rescue helmet. Visible work cue: One clean climbing-rope bight with free ends sits beside an elongated locking carabiner. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a rescue helmet.
